en.headline: Court jails man for life over murder of yoga instructor ex-girlfriend
en.dek: High Court judge says Lo Chun-ming had every intention to kill and sentences him after jury conviction yesterday.
body: A High Court judge on Friday sentenced former legal assistant Lo Chun-ming, 32, to life imprisonment for murdering his yoga instructor ex-girlfriend Chow Wai-yin at a luxury hotel in 2022.

Mr Justice Anthony Kwok Kai-on passed the mandatory sentence after a jury unanimously convicted Lo the previous day of unlawfully killing Chow with a knife at the Ritz-Carlton in West Kowloon on 29 and 30 June 2022.

The judge said Lo had every intention to kill. He noted that even if the victim had provoked the defendant, an ordinary person would not have responded by stabbing her repeatedly in such a cruel manner that caused her pain and terror.
Chow, who was 23 at the time, was found in a blood-filled bathtub in the hotel room. Autopsy findings indicated she sustained more than 40 wounds.

In a mitigation letter, Lo apologised to Chow and her family and said she was the woman he loved most. The judge responded that if he had truly loved her, he should have let her go instead of killing her.
Correction: A character error in the Chinese version has been fixed.

zh.headline: 瑜伽導師被殺案 前男友謀殺罪成判終身監禁
zh.dek: 高等法院法官指被告有殺害意圖，陪審團昨日一致裁定罪成後今日判刑。
body: 高等法院法官周五判處前法律助理勞浚銘終身監禁，他被陪審團一致裁定謀殺前女友瑜伽導師周慧賢罪成。
郭啟安法官在陪審團昨日裁定罪成後，依例判處終身監禁。案情指勞於2022年6月29日至30日在西九龍麗思卡爾頓酒店以利刀殺害周慧賢。
法官表示，被告有殺害意圖，即使死者有挑釀，常人也不會以如此殘忍方式用刀殺害，令死者痛苦及恐懼。
周慧賢當時23歲，屍體在酒店房間浴缸中被發現，浴缸充滿血水。驗屍報告顯示她身中超過40刀。
勞在求情信中向周及其家屬道歉，並稱她是自己最心愛的女人。法官回應，若真深愛她，便應放手讓她離開，而非殺害。
更正：中文版本中的字符錯誤已修正。
